d:
A massive bipedal rock-type creature resembling a volcano, featuring a charcoal grey hide with bright orange magma-like veins flowing across the body. The head is small and recessed into a bulky neck, with a single large, orange, glowing vent on the forehead. It has three thick, charcoal-colored claws on each hand and thick, sturdy legs. It has no tail and no wings.
BODY COLOR: charcoal grey
